ruleDefinitions.name: Operator Bloopers Cobalt Strike Modules
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Cobalt Strike module/commands accidentally entered in CMD shell

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-UserHunter.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-ShareFinder.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Kerberoast.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-SMBAutoBrute.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Nightmare.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*zerologon.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*av\\_query.*")))
